QuestInfo.name: Fairy Knowledge
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says that not many know of the Moonlight Sonata and tells you that the #bfairies in Ellinia#k may know.  She advises you to ask #bRowen the Fairy, Wing the Fairy, and Arwen the Fairy# to find out who you need to talk to.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Rowen, Wing, and Arwen the Fairy about the Moonlight Sonata and found out that #bGold Richie bought some very rare sheet music at auction. You aren't sure what kind of sheet music it was, but you also heard that Gold Richie said something like 'Soon the moonlight will be mine' before the auction started.#k
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 500
Can proceed to the 'Lost Moonlight Sonata' quest

0.0: The Moon Bunnies used to sing it every full moon during the fall. Many knew about the song back then, but now, not so many. I can promise that if I don't know about it, then nobody does.
0.1: Right! I don't know anything about that song, but the fairies really enjoy music. They might know something. The #bfairies of Ellinia#k love to talk about rumors, so how about going and meeting them?

yes.0: Go see #bRowen, Wing, and Arwen#k in Ellinia. The three of them really like music. I'll also add this advice... The fairies in Ellinia are not very friendly towards humans. If you would like to get information from them, I suggest that you prepare a gift for them.
yes.1: The fairies like shiny things. #bFor example, things like gold or gems#k. After you talk to them, you should know what to look for.

no.0: Well, I don't know who else you can ask. You should leave now. As I mentioned before, I am busy.

1.0: What brings you here, #b#h0##k? Don't be surprised. Look, I am a trader. The foundation of good trade is information! I have information about many people. So, it's not so strange that I know your name, is it?\r\n#L0##bI hear you have the 'Moonlight Sonata Sheet Music'?#l\n#k
1.1: Lower your voice. Who did you... Who did you hear that from? I never told anybody...
